items.text: Dies from Hypoxia multiple times. Gets a warrant every time I leave the station with no explanation of the crime. Great spacer game 10/10 would play again.
items.text_zh: 因缺氧多次死亡。每次我离开空间站都会拿到逮捕令，却没有任何犯罪解释。很棒的空间游戏，10/10，会再玩。

observations.description: 离开空间站时无故获得通缉令
observations.evidence: Gets a warrant every time I leave the station with no explanation of the crime.
observations.evidence_zh: 每次我离开空间站都会得到一个逮捕令，却没有任何关于罪行的解释。
